name: 01-mixed-board
description: The common case: several open findings across severities, board audience. Exercises the citation contract under normal load.

findings.title: HTTP does not redirect to HTTPS
findings.plain_english: Visitors who type the address without https can be intercepted. Force the secure version.
findings.remediation: Configure a permanent (301/308) redirect from http:// to https:// at the CDN or web server.

findings.title: No privacy policy link found
findings.plain_english: Visitors cannot find how their data is used. Most privacy laws require this link.
findings.remediation: Add a visible footer link to a current privacy policy on every page.

findings.title: Third-party trackers loaded before consent could be verified
findings.plain_english: The site uses tracking tools. Depending on where visitors live, consent may be required first.
findings.remediation: Confirm a consent mechanism gates these scripts where required, and list them in the privacy policy.

findings.title: Missing Content-Security-Policy
findings.plain_english: There is no policy limiting which scripts can run on the page. This is the main defense against injected code.
findings.remediation: Publish a CSP. Start in report-only mode, then enforce script-src and object-src restrictions.

findings.title: Missing Referrer-Policy
findings.plain_english: Full page addresses may leak to other sites when visitors click outbound links.
